title: Homecoming and Locker
author: Jude Quintana
blurb: Rosalind Winterbourne, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
